review_notes: Independently reviewed all 199 lines of the input proposal, all 49 lines of functionality.md, all 494 lines of dispositions.json, and all 15 lines of link-dispositions.json. Reviewed both canonical and rendered versions of every owned source/header line and enumerated all eight subjects and all baseline links.

The six proposed writes concern owned subjects, preserve canonical identifiers, and accurately refine the source-level dispatcher contract. No entity, merge, new-link, or follow-up mutations are proposed. Nine section-attribution facts are explicitly deferred rather than promoted from source syntax to compiled-layout proof.

All 65 explicit cases from 0x479 through 0x4B9 were inspected, including the reordered 0x4A1–0x4A8 cases and the shared 0x4B6/0x4B7 scale path. Unsupported IDs still select synchronous mode and reach the common epilogue. The caller independently confirms that 0x478 reaches this dispatcher, that 0x4BA does not, and that the conditional 0x479-to-0x506 fallback belongs to efSync_Spawn. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L19-L545 and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efsync.c#L65-L83.

The prepared-va_list distinction and conditional argument consumption are supported. Local payload extraction is pointer-valued, not by-value floating-point extraction. The 0x49D recipe consumes one position pointer and, after successful creation, one sign pointer and one angle pointer; its two lexical angle reads are mutually exclusive. Forwarded helper definitions confirm joint-then-conditional-sign consumption and joint-plus-owner-scale behavior. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L12-L29, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L298-L321, and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.c#L791-L834.

The independent secondary-generator cases 0x47A, 0x49F, and 0x4B1 do not assign the secondary result to ret_obj. The linked recipes retain preceding successful nodes without local rollback. These are normal constructor-return-path statements, not guarantees against arbitrary reentrant callbacks or exceptional execution. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L38-L56, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L153-L251, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L325-L344, and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L465-L497.

Queue producer and consumer source agree on pointer-slot use rather than ordinary EF_ParamEntry array indexing: the producer casts to HSD_JObj**, while the dispatcher advances through u32 words before reading the first field. The proposal's pointer-sized wording is valid for the intended target source convention, not a new independently proved compiled-layout claim. Zero count skips the drain; negative or otherwise invalid counts are unchecked. Immediate animation in 0x4A9/0x4AA can precede animation of the same queued root. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.h#L11-L16, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.h#L121-L122, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.c#L515-L529, and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L534-L544.

Exceptional-float review: the local sign branches test strictly less than zero. Under ordinary floating-point comparison semantics, negative infinity selects the negative quarter-turn; positive infinity, both signed zeros, and unordered NaN select the positive branch. Angle and scale inputs receive no local finiteness checks. The functionality summary's nonnegative wording should not be read as excluding the unordered else path. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L42-L53 and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/efalt.c#L301-L318.

Cross-file ownership and callback checks support the proposal's deliberately limited claims. Model objects register efLib_Update and user-data cleanup; updates decrement lifetime before animation and callback invocation. The 0x494 callback can change lifetime, clear itself, and request transition frames, so lifetime65 is initialization rather than a fixed total duration. Attached generators store the joint and increment its reference count. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.c#L337-L350, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.c#L387-L430, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.c#L495-L535, code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ef/eflib.c#L1095-L1124, and code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/sysdolphin/baselib/generator.c#L1022-L1037.

No gameplay identity was inferred from numeric recipe IDs or callback names. The raw owner-data access in 0x494 remains a literal source operation, not proof of fighter joint names or compiled owner layout. Renderer diagnostics and unchanged rendered names were not used as independent semantic evidence.

fact_dispositions.reason: The graphics-ID-controlled switch is proved, but its attribution to this compiled .data record is not. Preserve the section-specific claim as deferred pending compiled evidence.
Sixty-five source cases do not prove a 65-entry compiled jump table, a 300-byte payload, or the nature of residual bytes. Archival match references are not independently inspected compiled evidence.
The proposed role is plausible, but the source does not associate a concrete .data object with the switch. The ledger correctly defers this purpose claim.
The failed null check passes diagnostic literals to __assert, but their placement in this .sdata blob and the exclusive use of that blob are not established.
Literal spellings are visible; the 13-byte extent, packing, and padding attribution require compiled section evidence.
The diagnostic purpose of the literals is established, but the subject-specific claim that this section stores them remains deferred.
The comparison, rotation, and subtraction operations are proved. Their flow from this particular .sdata2 record is not proved by source literals.
Source floating-point types and literals do not prove a 36-byte constant pool or its concrete emitted representations and organization.
The function uses these floating-point values, but section ownership and attribution remain unverified. No replacement section fact is proposed.

The proposed data-flow refinement is supported: distinguish unreturned independent generators, conditional linked models, and the owner-derived triple composition. The original rationale's queued-GObj description is less precise than the actual JObj-pointer producer.

The proposed signature and prepared-list explanation correctly distinguish the dispatcher from an ellipsis entry point and describe pointer payloads, recipe-dependent consumption, and owner requirements.

The proposed purpose adds supported unsupported-ID side effects and partial-success behavior. A failed later component does not necessarily null the primary result, and a null primary does not imply that no secondary generator was created.

The proposed state description correctly states that this function neither resets the entry count nor restores the previous load mode, and identifies immediate animation followed by a possible queued animation. Queue completion is interpreted under the valid-state, terminating-execution qualification explicitly recorded in functionality.md.

The proposed TU data-flow statement correctly narrows scalar extraction to pointed-to values, distinguishes primary results from other created objects, and explains the source's queue indexing convention.
The complete canonical switch and common epilogue directly support the TU's alternate synchronous dispatcher purpose. No correction requiring an additional write is needed.

The proposed refinement correctly separates the caller's queue reset from this TU's behavior and notes the absence of save/restore isolation. Count-zero completion and preservation of earlier composition nodes describe ordinary valid execution, not malformed counts or arbitrary callback interference.

unresolved.detail: All nine facts on .data, .sdata, and .sdata2 remain unresolved. Neither source syntax nor archived match descriptions establish current compiled byte extents, jump-table placement, string placement, padding, or floating-constant pool organization.

The literal access through owner user_data+0x5E8 and indices 0xB0/4 is established. Semantic joint identities and compiled owner layout are not. The callback casts stored user_data to HSD_JObj* and reads scale.x; compatibility with the original owner payload must not be inferred from that cast.

Negative counts, invalid queue pointers, nested spawning, and mutation during animation are not guarded or isolated here. Reverse-order draining and count-zero completion require valid shared state and terminating execution. Source-level pointer-slot agreement does not constitute fresh compiled-layout verification.

The TU does not validate argument arity, pointer validity, required model children, resource-table availability, or the lifetime of owner data retained for callbacks. Constructor and generator definitions substantiate normal creation behavior, not a blanket safety or lifetime guarantee.

No character, move, visual identity, or semantic fighter-part mapping is established solely from numeric IDs, raw offsets, or existing callback names. The accepted proposal appropriately makes no such writes.
